notes: The identity of BetterClipboard's Microsoft Store package (docs/microsoft-store.md).
Partner Center assigned these values when the name 'BetterClipboard' was reserved on 2026-11-13:
Product management > Product identity > Package/Identity/Name, Package/Identity/Publisher and
Package/Properties/PublisherDisplayName. They must stay exactly as they are (case included): the Store refuses
a package whose identity differs, and a package with another identity is another app to Windows.
'displayName' is the reserved app name (the Store refuses a package whose display name is not reserved).
'storeId' is the product's Store ID: tools/release/submit-store.ps1 sends updates to it, and
https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/<storeId> is the listing. 'packageFamilyName' is what Windows calls the
installed package (its data folder is %LOCALAPPDATA%\Packages\<packageFamilyName>); it follows from the
name and the publisher and is here for reference only.
A test package (package-msix.ps1 -NewTestCertificate) keeps the name and takes its publisher from the test
certificate, so it is a different package family and installs next to the Store's. Nothing here is a secret.
